fix_subject: Fix filter combiner not pruning unsatisfiable bounds at same constant

labels.summary: The filter combiner mishandled range bounds with the same constant, so it did not correctly identify unsatisfiable conditions such as `x < c AND x > c` and treated the inclusive-versus-exclusive cases incorrectly; the change returns UNSATISFIABLE unless both bounds are inclusive (<= and >=).
